description: This file defines a React component for an autocomplete input with various subcomponents and utility functions, utilizing external UI libraries and icons.

methods.name: AutocompleteInput
methods.description: A React component for an autocomplete input field with optional trigger and clear buttons, supporting different sizes and start addons.

methods.name: AutocompletePopup
methods.description: A React component for rendering the autocomplete popup with positioning and styling.

methods.name: AutocompleteItem
methods.description: A React component representing an individual autocomplete item.

methods.name: AutocompleteSeparator
methods.description: A React component for rendering a separator within the autocomplete list.

methods.name: AutocompleteGroup
methods.description: A React component for grouping autocomplete items.

methods.name: AutocompleteGroupLabel
methods.description: A React component for labeling groups within the autocomplete list.

methods.name: AutocompleteEmpty
methods.description: A React component for displaying a message when the autocomplete list is empty.

methods.name: AutocompleteRow
methods.description: A React component for rendering a row within the autocomplete list.

methods.name: AutocompleteValue
methods.description: A React component for displaying the current value of the autocomplete.

methods.name: AutocompleteList
methods.description: A React component for rendering the list of autocomplete options, wrapped in a scroll area.

methods.name: AutocompleteClear
methods.description: A React component for the clear button in the autocomplete input.

methods.name: AutocompleteStatus
methods.description: A React component for displaying status messages related to autocomplete.

methods.name: AutocompleteCollection
methods.description: A React component for managing the collection of autocomplete items.

methods.name: AutocompleteTrigger
methods.description: A React component for the trigger button to open/close the autocomplete.

methods.name: useAutocompleteFilter
methods.description: A hook for filtering autocomplete options.
